avis.titre: Lightweight, Non-Oily Sunscreen That Actually Works for Me
avis.texte: This sunscreen has worked really well for me, especially since I usually avoid sunscreen because I hate the oily, greasy feeling most of them leave behind. Everyone’s skin is different, but this one felt completely different from what I’m used to. After applying it, my skin felt dry and lightweight with no oily residue at all. It also didn’t spread everywhere or transfer onto things like my car seats, which has been a big issue for me with other sunscreens that leave white marks. Because of that, I’ve actually been consistent about using it, which says a lot. Overall, it’s a great option if you want strong sun protection without the greasy feel.

Love, loveeee, LOVEEEE this sunscreen, it’s my favorite it’s honestly prefect, no complaints. It doesn’t leave me greasy or oily, it gives you that nice sunscreen glow. I wish they had it in bigger sizes. Wish it was a little cheaper, but honestly, I’m so particular about products I like, so I’m most likely going to use this as long as it’s available. I hope it’s still around when I’m 80.
I really like this sunscreen! It’s super smooth and light on my face. I haven’t had any breakouts and I have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Good so far! Just a bit small
avis.texte: I have dry-combo to normal skin, a bit oily near my nose depending on the weather condition. This sun screen is so light weight, a bit scented, absorbs well, it feels moisturizing and not drying at all. I wanted a sunscreen that sits well under makeup and I hate thick sunscreens that can potentially peel under base makeup, but this is sunscreen is so nice and light. My only problem is why is it so small?? I think it won’t last long especially if I reapply during the day.
Doesn't feel too sticky or dry it just feels like skin. I have oily acne prone skin so I skip face moisturizer.
This item is very high protection strongly recommend for all skin type
love it! my original sunscreen got a new formula and left a white caste. thankfully this one doesn’t leave a caste at all and works well with my tinted moisturizer.

avis.titre: smells great, is light weight and leaves no white cast
avis.texte: I have to admit, I've spent most of my life not taking the use of sunscreen seriously which is terrible. Maybe this is due to when I was born since I don't remember people making that big of a deal about wearing sunscreen when I was a child in the 80s and 90s. You wore it when you knew you were at high risk of burning but that's about it. Recently, I started actually taking skin care seriously and have started using a variety of skin care products. A lot of them stress the importance of using SPF due to them causing an increase in sensitivity to UV rays making you more prone to sun damage. I can't stand the way regular sunscreen feels though especially on the face. I hate that it always feels thick and greasy as it just makes me not want to use it. I've heard people rave about skin care sunscreens due to them not feeling like regular sunscreen on the skin so when I saw this Cell Fusion C Aquatica UV Defense Sunscreen, I thought it would be a great one to try. What I love about this sunscreen is that it's super lightweight and once it soaks in, you can't even tell you put it on your skin. I'm not someone that wears makeup but I would assume this would make this a great sunscreen to wear with it. I also love that it has that classic sunscreen scent but isn't over powering. This sunscreen goes on smoothly and leaves no white cast at all. It also can be used in place of your moisturizer. avis.titre: Packed With Skin-Loving Ingredients, but Doesn't Have the Korean Sunscreen Feel
avis.texte: I picked up this sunscreen primarily because it’s a brand I recognized seeing in Korea. I expected that same lightweight, cosmetically elegant formula that Korean sunscreens are known for. What I forgot to consider was that this version is being sold on Amazon in the US, which means it’s the U.S. formulation and therefore uses FDA-approved filters like avobenzone, homosalate, octisalate, and octocrylene rather than the newer-generation Korean filters (like Uvinul or Tinosorb) I typically prefer. That said, while the filter combo isn’t my favorite, it’s not bad. It offers solid broad spectrum protection but in terms of coverage it’s a bit heavier and not as cosmetically elegant as my favorite Korean sunscreens. However, it still contains a ton of skincare ingredients that my skin loves, which is also another thing I love about Korean skincare formulations. This is loaded with ingredients my skin loves, including hydrators like glycerin, panthenol, sodium hyaluronate, and sodium hyaluronic acid. There are soothing extracts like camellia sinensis leaf extract, centella asiatica, and others. There are also a ton antioxidants including vitamin e, green tea, and even some fermented ingredients. So while the filters are very much like U.S. sunscreens, the formulation is still almost like a serum-sunscreen hybrid. avis.titre: Effective Korean SPF 50 sunscreen loaded with hydrators and plant extracts.
avis.texte: I tried this sunscreen primarily because I use sunscreen daily and I saw this product was made in Korea, a country renown for their skin care and especially sun screen. In short this seems to be a good SPF 50 formulation that doesn’t dry my skin and leaves no white cast. I found it effective as expected, but it is not my favorite sunscreen. More details follow. My sun screen came in a blue Cell Fusion C-branded box about 2 inches wide by 1 ¼ inches deep and 6 ½ inches tall. While this product is made in Korea, ingredients and instructions were only in English. On the back are active ingredients: octocrylene (9%), homosalate (7.3%), octisalate (5.0%) and avobenzone (3%), all of which are sun screens and provide broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays. Other ingredients are listed on the side of the box and are included at the end of my review*. To my knowledge, key inactive ingredients provide hydration (sodium hyaluronate, hyaluronic acid, glycols, panthenol, and glucosamines); while plant-extracts (camellia sinensis, chlorella vulgaris extract, moringa oleiferal, centella asiatica, houttuynia cordata, melia azadirachta, turmeric, thyme, mentha rotundifolia, althaea rosea) sooth and protect the skin. These ingredients make this sunscreen a bit of a skin-serum/ sunscreen hybrid compared to many U.S. based brands. The bottom line is, however, no ingredient causes me concern. avis.titre: Easy to apply sunscreen blends in effortlessly and provides effective sun protection
avis.texte: I'm very happy with this Aquatica UV Defense Face Sunscreen by Cell Fusion C that I ordered from Amazon. This facial sunscreen is SPF 50, and it works very well to protect my skin from sun damage. This sunscreen is a non-greasy formula that is hydrating to skin, and it does not irritate my sensitive skin or cause any breakouts. Aquatica UV Defense sunscreen has a pleasant fragrance, too, it is very subtle but I like that it smells more herbal rather than chemical. This sunscreen applies easily, with a cooling sensation when I first apply it, and zero white cast left behind. The finish is invisible - this formula blends in seamlessly and does not cause any greasiness or shine. This sunscreen does not conflict with my other skin treatments or cosmetics, it layers well with the other products I use regularly.

I got this sunscreen because I live in Florida and the sun can be intense here. With my sensitive skin I have to be careful. This stuff is great. It is lightweight and has no sticky feel to it. There is no harsh chemical smell. My skin didn’t get irritated or burned after working in my backyard. It was moisturizing which was a good thing. I was very impressed with the results.

avis.titre: It's that time of year and we all need sunscreen nearby
avis.texte: I ordered this b/c I wanted something that might hydrate my skin at the same time it provides SPF 50, which this does. This is a smaller tube at 1.69 oz, but it fits well in your backpack (or whatever) when you go outside. It feels smooth gliding on the skin with very little scent, which I appreciate. As far as the ingredients, my pics show the active ingredients and note that they are somewhat different from what it says on the box vs. what is on the tube. The inactive ingredients list is so long (with small print on the box) that I blew it up and divided it into 2 pics to show them all in case anyone is interested. While I think this is very good sunscreen to have, the price is high for the amount you receive, hence 4 stars. However, better quality often costs more, and not getting a sunburn is a proactive outcome.

This is a nice light weight sunscreen. It blends nicely without leaving a white cast. It does have a little bit of a scent but it wears off quickly. It doesn't feel as smooth or well defined as some other Korean sunscreens we've tried. Overall It's a good sunscreen but it does have some questionable ingredients which are endocrine disruptors, I'm not sure I would get this particular sunscreen again just based on those ingredients.

Nice packaging and goes on really smooth. It doesn’t have a strong scent and a nice high spf. Absorbs into skin nicely. This does have a weird cooling sensation when applying that sticks around for a couple of minutes. I love that it doesn’t make my skin feel oily or have a greasy finish.

avis.titre: Not white cast but does have a sheen afterglow
avis.texte: This SPF cream feels light enough for daily wear. It doesn't leave a white cast and goes on rather smooth. I did notice that immediately after applying the sun screen, my skin felt a little sticky but if I allowed it dry, that feeling goes away. The sun screen is hydrating and blends into my skin cleanly. I thought the sun screen also left my skin looking a little more shinier as well.

avis.titre: Light weight, no white cast, but it does have sunscreen smell
avis.texte: I like this sunscreen because it it lightweight and sits clear on my medium toned skin. There is NO white cast. It is not greasy, but I do feel it on my skin. It has a slightly refreshing feeling as I apply it, which is better than heavy sunscreens in the summer. This does have a sunscreen smell, unfortunately. It's not worse than other brands, but I was hoping for no smell.
